learning_outcomes.text: Know the essential main assemblies of passenger cars and be able to explain their function and basic designs.

Understand the relationships of essential vehicle characteristics in the overall vehicle, especially the relationships to driving resistances and driving dynamics, and be able to evaluate drive concepts regarding their suitability in passenger cars and assess their properties.
Know the assemblies of the powertrain and chassis of a passenger car and be able to describe their functionalities.
Be able to explain the electrical system and essential bus systems in the vehicle (LIN, CAN, MOST, FlexRay, automotive Ethernet).
Understand the fundamentals of vehicle safety and their relationships to the overall vehicle, and understand the fundamentals of automated driving.
Understand the basic terms and methods of type approval for passenger cars/road vehicles (USA, China and Europe).
